The main changes in each version, newest first.

### 0.7.3 (2026-10-21)

- Stopping a deck with the echo on now lets the echo tail ring out (before, stopping cut the tail too). Turning the echo down to 0 also lets the tail finish before cutting out
- The crossfader on the screen now works with the mouse (click the track to jump there, drag to follow, double-click to center)
- With Quantize on, PLAY on a stopped deck waits for the other deck's next bar before it starts
- Fixed PLAY starting slightly early (by 10 to 25 ms)
- With loop on, scratching on the platter or the waveform now wraps across the loop's edges
- The deck now responds faster to the first movement after holding the platter, and sound processing is slightly lighter
- New chapter in the manual: "FAQ (how it works and other software)"
- CREDITS: added OtoMadSampler, and the TIME-1 link now points to its own repository

### 0.7.2 (2026-10-17)

- New script `reascratch_lanes.lua` and the `LANES` button on toolbar 3: show or hide the envelope lanes by group (hand-made scratch, recorded effects, performance lanes)
- The FX window of the performance lanes (`DJ performance lanes`) now shows each lane's value in a table (the number of columns follows the window's width). The parameter names are shorter
- Updated screenshots in the manual to reflect the current screen with LANES

### 0.7.1 (2026-10-17)

- New section in the manual, [“Things that depend on your setup”](things-that-depend-on-your-setup.md) (sound, video, controllers and keyboard, REAPER and the PC, where files go), and what you need to hear the headphone cue apart from the main output
- Setup: keeps what was on toolbar 3 or in a window set before replacing it, says so in REAPER's console when the autostart cannot start the video sync (the kit moved, for example), and asks for the Cue output again when the current audio device does not have it
- Fixes in the manual (the names of the MIDI settings pages and more)

### 0.7 (2026-10-16)

- More controllers: presets grew from 62 to 122 (sorted A–Z by maker; those not yet tested on the hardware are marked ⚠︎), four more models for the HID bridge including the Traktor Kontrol S3, and diagrams of 66 controllers in the manual
- Eight pad modes (auto loop, TOUCH FX, slicer, BOUNCE LOOP and more), loops, CUE LOOP, eight DJ filter types, and both decks from a single APC40 mkII or mkI
- Button lights (in the hot cue colours, turned off when REAPER closes), two controllers at once (Reloop Buddy + APC40 mkII), and the setup `Learn` tab (make your own preset) and `More` tab
- 29 video transitions (wipes, irises, camera moves, Brush wipe, Shatter and more), driven directly by the crossfader position
- Video effects expanded to 15 (VHS, Disc, Line art, Halftone and Zoom blur added), an LFO that moves the amount with the beat, a matching sound effect for each, and effects recorded into envelopes when you record a performance
- `LOAD` button: put a file chosen in the Media Explorer into a deck while you play (audio-only files show a spinning speaker; heavy videos are converted to all-intra in the background). The LOAD button now works on 13 more units (Hercules Inpulse, Reloop Terminal Mix and others; before, it did nothing on them even though they have one). Loading by dragging a file from the Media Explorer or the Explorer onto the window
- Previewing a Media Explorer file (the `P` key, or a button on most controllers: the sound in the headphones only, the picture only in the deck's record, never in the video window)
- A metronome (a click on a deck's beats, the first beat of each bar higher; the `N` key, the window in the record's corner, a MIDI button; most presets set the button; the second APC40's `METRONOME` now turns it on/off instead of REAPER's own metronome)
- Importing rekordbox XML (hot cues, memory cues, BPM and beat grid, key), loading Traktor and VirtualDJ track data, writing out track data (an XML for rekordbox or ReaScratch track data), beat maps for songs whose tempo changes partway, and key detection with KEY SYNC
- Tempo and BPM: BPM-based tempo ranges (±5 to ±60 BPM, default ±20 BPM), typing the BPM on the screen, sync with REAPER's own tempo, BPM detection for short loops, and beat, bar and loop lines on the waveform
- Performance lanes (what you do on the decks while REAPER records is recorded on REAPER's timeline and plays back from REAPER's play button in `PERF PLAY` performance playback mode)
- Auto gain per sample (the loudness is measured on import and LOAD and brought to a target; setup's `Samples` tab), and swing for patterns played from the PATTERN pads
- Brake length in beats, PAUSE quantize, and a fix for the Reloop Buddy tempo fader (not working, and running the wrong way)
- Fixed: an empty deck showing the other deck's picture (the black picture of an empty slot did not loop), and the preview's picture flickering on an empty deck B
- Projects saved with 0.6 or earlier are no longer converted from the old save format (choose the preset and other settings again in setup). The old names of the capture tracks (before 2026-10-08: “撮る A / B / 完成”) are no longer converted either

### 0.6 (2026-10-07)

- Cue: listen to a deck on headphones (Cue mix, and the output device is chosen from a list and remembered)
- More controllers: presets grew from 6 to 62 (DDJ-FLX2 and other DDJ models, CDJ-2000NXS2, CDJ-3000, and models from Reloop, Numark, Hercules and Denon DJ)
- The setup `Preset` menu is now three levels: maker → model → deck
- HID bridge for HID controllers (NI Traktor Kontrol S4 MK3 and S2 MK3)
- Channel faders and headphone CUE on the DDJ-FLX4
- Fine adjustment, crossfader, volume, Cue and video effects from the keyboard
- Projector output (handles screens being plugged in and out)
- Running setup again keeps each deck's settings, saved data and envelopes
- Fixed: quantized hot cue landings drifting further each time, and wrong choices on the setup screen

### 0.5 (2026-10-06)

- Recording a performance into envelopes
- Capturing a performance (each deck's sound and video, and a finished video that matches the screen; older FFmpeg versions supported)
- The crossfader while stopped, and video effects on still-image decks, now show in the video
- ANSI-style block-letter logo, a new top row (`sync`, `Q`, `memory`) and `help`
- A warning in setup when REAPER's video cache is long enough to delay the crossfader in the video
- Fixed: Trails getting darker; with the Reloop Buddy, the crossfader video lagging, the jog drifting and hot cues landing off the beat

### 0.4 (2026-10-05)

- Optimised for the Reloop Buddy (deck 2 preset, pad modes, 10-bit tempo, volume, FX)
- Eight hot cues, and PLAY quantize
- Swing (16th-note shuffle)
- Scratching from envelopes (place the included patterns, rearrange and save them, fit them to the swing)
- A crossfader picture in the bottom strip, and even the briefest crossfader cut always shows in the video
- Shorter help text in the bottom strip, with long text scrolling
- Fixed: a stopped deck B flashing black and jittering

### 0.3 (2026-10-04)

- A second deck (deck B), with the crossfader layering the two videos (nine blend modes)
- Ten video effects (on each deck's picture and on the mixed picture)
- Tempo (change the speed without changing the pitch) and SYNC
- Sample switching (up to 8; each sample keeps its own position and cues)
- Memory cues (up to 32), and hot cue buttons above the frame
- Beat-quantized jumps, with BPM detected on import
- Brake, start-up and spinback
- Left-handed layout (`Layout`), and a list of keyboard shortcuts (`keys` button or `?` key)
- Large videos scaled down on import (height 720, 540 or 360), samples loaded a little at a time, and a load test script that counts dropouts

### 0.2 (2026-10-03)

- Crossfader cuts (adjustable cut-in gap and width; the video also disappears while the sound is cut)
- A record platter you turn with the mouse
- Four hot cues (a short press jumps; hold to return on release), and a CDJ-style CUE button
- SLIP mode
- Search by clicking or dragging the whole-track waveform, and a redesigned waveform
- Tape-style sound where the pitch changes (the `tape` bar), with the record coasting on after you let go
- Maximum song length raised to about 23 minutes, and FFmpeg preferred for all-intra conversion
- Fixed: the Space key being taken by REAPER itself, and imported audio going silent partway when rendered

### 0.1 (2026-10-02)

- First release
- Pitch-locked scratching (grains always play at normal speed), with the video showing the frame at the playback position
- Video import (writes the audio to a WAV) and conversion to all-intra (MJPEG)
- Presets: DDJ-FLX4 (deck 1 and deck 2), APC40 mkII (two single-deck presets), Reloop Buddy (deck 1) and Custom
- DOS-style screen (two-row waveform of the whole track and a zoomed view, knobs, lamps, setup screen)
- Use without a controller (drag the zoomed waveform to scratch; play/stop, CUE and freeze from the keyboard)
- An option to start the video sync automatically when REAPER starts
